text:
[2026-05-10 do-beads triage] Extending MailBackend::query_objects to accept filter/sort args is a SemVer break on the canonical extension-server backend trait; per workspace AGENTS.md cookie-cutter rule it would propagate to every extension-server crate (chat, calendars, contacts, tasks, filenode, sharing).

Per the jmap-server AGENTS.md policy ('Prefer non-breaking changes. Reshape only when the workspace is bumping a major.'), this should ride alongside the other 0.2.0-class API breaks: JMAP-g7wu.1 (CallerCtx forwarding), JMAP-g7wu.3 (helpers builder), JMAP-g7wu.9 (UTCDate newtype), JMAP-r3pg.14 (extract_account_id clean fix).

Decision needed from human:
1. Land now as isolated breaking change (rejects cookie-cutter coordination policy).
2. Bundle into coordinated 0.2.0 push (recommended).
3. Defer indefinitely until IMAP-migration workload demands it.

Recommendation: option 2. Filter-pushdown shape matters more once a real backend exists (post hwdv.5/.6/.7 greenfield refs), so the canonical signature can be designed against actual implementations rather than the current MemoryBackend's hand-rolled loop.

Filed per workspace AGENTS.md 'Turn questions into beads' rule rather than claiming and beginning a workspace-wide breaking change without coordination.
